title: China’s crypto pivot could help Bitcoin shake off market FUD – Here’s how!
summary: China’s crypto access push comes at a key time as bitcoin selling pressure starts to build.
content: China's potential pivot toward cryptocurrency access could arrive at a crucial moment for Bitcoin. As selling pressure begins to build in the broader market, renewed engagement from the region might help alleviate negative sentiment and market uncertainty, providing a much-needed boost to investor confidence and stabilizing price trends.

title: Polymarket Rebuilds Its Core With Protocol V2 And pUSD Collateral
summary: Polymarket has begun testing Protocol V2, a major rebuild of the smart contracts behind its prediction markets. The architecture consolidates markets around a unified exchange system and pUSD collateral, with canary testing expected to continue through October 30 ahead of a tentative November 2 transition for new markets.
content: Polymarket is testing Protocol V2, which is a major rebuild of the smart contracts powering its prediction markets. The new architecture features a unified exchange system and pUSD collateral. Canary testing is scheduled through October 30, followed by a tentative November 2 transition for new markets.

summary:

A training program for automotive professionals, the Academy provides hundreds of e-learning courses, instructor-led training through 15 training centers, and certifications. The partnership with Whatfix is part of an initiative Read more...
The post Digital Adoption Platform Whatfix Partners with LKQ Europe appeared first on Finovate.
content: Automotive aftermarket parts distributor LKQ Europe has partnered with Digital Adoption Platform Whatfix. LKQ Europe will deploy Whatfix's Digital Adoption Platform and Product Analytics across the LKQ Academy, a comprehensive training program for automotive professionals offering e-learning courses, instructor-led training, and certifications. This collaboration aims to enhance the learning experience and support the digital initiatives of the training academy.

title: Anthropic Launches Haiku 5.5: Its Cheapest and Fastest Claude Model Yet
summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs about 75% less to run than its predecessor and targets high-volume jobs like summaries and live customer support. It arrives 15 days after Opus 5.5.
content: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5, its most affordable and fastest model to date. The new AI costs about 75 percent less to run than the previous version and is designed for high-volume tasks such as summaries and live customer support. The release follows just 15 days after the introduction of Opus 5.5, expanding the company's latest lineup.

title: Consumers Get Choosier About Credit
summary:
Consumer credit is still growing, but consumers eased off the form of borrowing they can adjust most readily from month to month. Federal Reserve data released Wednesday (Oct. 7) show consumer credit expanded at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.9% in August, less than half July’s revised 4.1% pace and the slowest since May. […]
The post Consumers Get Choosier About Credit appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Consumer credit growth slowed significantly in August, expanding at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.9 percent. This was less than half of July's revised pace of 4.1 percent and marked the slowest growth rate since May. Federal Reserve data indicates that consumers are becoming much more selective and cautious about their short-term borrowing habits from month to month.
